19: "According to his honor" — (Hagahah: In the Yerushalmi, the Tur brought it, that one who shames a zaken gives him a litra d'dahava. End [of quote]. And the Sma brings it. And Morenu Harav Moshe [the Rama] ruled in Yoreh Deah siman 243 se'if 2 in the hagahah that a talmid chacham in the present time does not have the din of a talmid chacham regarding [the payment of] litra d'dahava. And this is from the Terumas HaDeshen. And so the Mahari"k wrote in shoresh 163. And in the responsa of Rabbi Yeshayah Mi'Trani the New, at the end of siman 47, he disagrees with this and rejects it with both hands, and holds that he does have the din of a talmid chacham regarding the litra d'dahava. And see further there.)
